Container.Name: beets-custom
Container.Overview: Custom beets build: core fork (fetchart subdirectory fix) plus originquery, classical_tags, and roon_artwork plugins. No web UI -- this container just stays alive; open its Console (or `docker exec -it beets-custom bash`) and run `beet import /music/incoming` etc. by hand. Build the image first: clone https://github.com/BruiserBrody17/beets-unraid on your Unraid box and run `docker build -t beets-custom:latest .` in it, then add this container.
